name: Plattenalbum
summary: MPD client that browses your music collection with large album covers and plays without playlists
description: Plattenalbum is a GTK4/libadwaita client for the Music Player Daemon. Browse artists and albums with big cover art, search your library, queue albums with a click, see lyrics and song info, and control playback from the window or a media key. It needs a running MPD server (0.24 or newer) on the same or another machine.
